description: Source code for date and time parsing and formatting functions used in Git, including conversions between tm and timestamp, date string formatting, and date parsing with support for various formats and timezones.

methods.name: tm_to_time_t
methods.description: Converts a struct tm to a time_t, without normalizing weekday and yearday.

methods.name: show_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date string based on the specified mode.

methods.name: date_mode_from_type
methods.description: Creates a date_mode struct from a date_mode_type enum.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a timestamp and formats it according to the specified mode.

methods.name: parse_expiry_date
methods.description: Parses a string into an expiry timestamp, handling special keywords like 'never' and 'now'.

methods.name: parse_date_format
methods.description: Parses a date format string into a date_mode struct.

methods.name: date_mode_release
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a date_mode struct.

methods.name: datestamp
methods.description: Generates a current timestamp string with timezone offset.
